name: design-master
description: Resource-first AI designer plugin for responsive pages, HTML decks, dashboards, motion and selective 3D.

interface.shortDescription: Research-first AI designer plugin for pages and decks
interface.longDescription: Selects relevant design references, extracts an executable design system, generates responsive pages or HTML presentations, conditionally uses charts, motion or 3D, and runs a unified quality review.
defaultPrompt: 研究参考案例后，为这个主题建立设计系统并制作页面。
把这些内容做成可演示的 HTML deck，先给设计方向。
审查这个页面的审美、UX、响应式和动效，并修正问题。
